description_en: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
readme_excerpt: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents. Quickstart | Showcase | Playground | Catalog | Docs | Discord HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. Use it locally with the CLI, from AI coding agents with skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
